testSources.purpose: Book XI physical order and non-numerical phrase seams; not published.

method.source: Independent minidom text-node projection from twelve SHA-pinned XML files; eleven published inputs and one explicitly test-only input. Every source-to-record slice and exact paragraph restoration is checked, including the markerless IV.276 paragraph and the pre-milestone VIII.255 continuation with their explicit paragraph separators. The Book I-V corpora, extraction reports and search bundles remain byte-for-byte identical to the accepted prior release. Book IX restored text is published; its seven inline footnotes and restored headings are excluded. Book X transparent bold formatting preserves running text without inventing editorial additions.
method.tokens: Every indexed Unicode word and original UTF-16 offset independently scanned in Python and JavaScript and compared with each serialized book index.
method.queries: All literal vocabulary per book, one exact phrase per interval, every neighboring citation seam, all nine book boundaries, bounded wildcard and explicit Boolean fixtures. Expected ASTs and sequential phrase scans do not import production parsing/tokenization. Published Book IX footnote exclusions, phrases across excluded notes, restored English intervals and Book X transparent formatting have focused checks. Combined selections preserve distinct same-numbered sections and keep phrases and Boolean conditions inside their own book.
method.language: English-only and mixed English/Latin collection requests verify Latin-only spelling equivalence and separate Boolean scopes.
method.exports: Concordance geometry, original context, reader parameters, source slices, source fingerprints, CSV decoding, negative-only units and zero-result summaries.

limitations: Coverage is the accepted Whiston Proem and Books I-X XML only; XI is a future-expansion test witness, not a published book.
This source/query acceptance does not establish a new translation text or collate printed editions; browser interaction is verified separately.
